title: Assistance Share After Earlier Hardship Waivers on an Ostomy Supply Program Enrollment
content:
For an Ostomy Supply Program financial-hardship waiver, a repeat share is part of the share that multiplies the capped waiver base and follows the program's earlier hardship waivers posted in the last 24 months: two or more earlier waivers set the repeat share, exactly one earlier waiver sets the once share, and no earlier waiver sets the full share.

The last 24 months are counted back from the day the waiver is worked out: an earlier waiver counts when fewer than 24 whole calendar months separate its posting date from that day.

| Earlier hardship waivers on the program in the last 24 months | Share set |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 50% (the repeat share) |
| Exactly one | 75% (the once share) |
| None | 100% (the full share) |

The capped waiver base is the waiver base of the named posting taken up to the cap room.

**Cases (hypothetical).** One earlier waiver posted 23 months ago counts and sets 75%. The same waiver posted 25 months ago no longer counts, so the full share of 100% is set. Two earlier waivers within the window set 50%; on a capped waiver base of USD 40.00 a 50% share gives USD 20.00.
